CREATE TRIGGER KntLinkiInsert ON CDN.KntGrupy FOR INSERT AS
DECLARE @GidTyp SMALLINT DECLARE @GidFirma INT DECLARE @GidNumer INT DECLARE @GroTyp SMALLINT DECLARE @GroFirma INT DECLARE @GroNumer INT DECLARE @InsertedGroNumer INT DECLARE @prevcount INT DECLARE @count INT
DECLARE TriggerCursor CURSOR FOR SELECT KnG_GIDTyp,KnG_GIDFirma,KnG_GIDNumer, KnG_GROTyp,KnG_GROFirma, KnG_GRONumer FROM INSERTED
OPEN TriggerCursor
FETCH NEXT FROM TriggerCursor INTO @GIDTyp,@GIDFirma,@GIDNumer,@GROTyp,@GROFirma,@GRONumer WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN SET @prevcount=0 SET @count=-1
--tu z INSERTED oczywiscie CREATE TABLE #gronumery(GN INT,C INT) IF (@GIDTyp=-32) BEGIN INSERT INTO #gronumery exec CDN.KntRodzice @GroNumer
IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CDN.KntLinki WHERE KnL_GRONumer=@GIDNumer)>0) BEGIN INSERT INTO CDN.KntLinki (KnL_GIDTyp,KnL_GIDFirma,KnL_GIDNumer,KnL_GIDLp,KnL_GrOTyp,KnL_GrOFirma,KnL_GrONumer,KnL_GrOLp,KnL_Lisc,KnL_LiczbaPowtorzen,KnL_TStampDataMod) SELECT KnL_GIDTyp,KnL_GIDFirma,KnL_GIDNumer,KnL_GIDLp,-32,@GROFirma,GN,0,0,0,DATEDIFF(S,'19900101',GETDATE()) FROM (SELECT CDN.KntLinki.KnL_GIDTyp,CDN.KntLinki.KnL_GIDFirma,CDN.KntLinki.KnL_GIDNumer,CDN.KntLinki.KnL_GIDLp,GN,Linki.KnL_GRONumer AS GRO FROM CDN.KntLinki RIGHT OUTER JOIN #gronumery ON KnL_GRONumer=@GIDNumer LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.KntLinki AS Linki ON Linki.KnL_GIDNumer=CDN.KntLinki.KnL_GIDNumer AND Linki.KnL_GIDTyp=CDN.KntLinki.KnL_GIDTyp AND Linki.KnL_GRONumer=GN) SelectWewn WHERE GRO IS NULL UPDATE CDN.KntLinki --update dla wszystkich elementow nalezacych do grupy, ktora zostala wstawiona SET KnL_LiczbaPowtorzen=KnL_LiczbaPowtorzen+(SELECT (C) FROM #gronumery WHERE KnL_GRONumer=GN), KnL_TStampDataMod = DATEDIFF(S,'19900101',GETDATE()) WHERE KnL_GRONumer IN (SELECT GN FROM #gronumery) AND KnL_GIDNumer IN (SELECT KnL_GIDNumer FROM CDN.KntLinki WHERE KnL_GRONumer=@GIDNumer) END TRUNCATE TABLE #gronumery --DROP TABLE #gronumery END INSERT INTO #gronumery exec CDN.KntRodzice @GroNumer
INSERT INTO CDN.KntLinki (KnL_GIDTyp,KnL_GIDFirma,KnL_GIDNumer,KnL_GIDLp,KnL_GrOTyp,KnL_GrOFirma,KnL_GrONumer,KnL_GrOLp,KnL_Lisc,KnL_LiczbaPowtorzen,KnL_TStampDataMod) SELECT @GIDTyp,@GIDFirma,@GIDNumer,0,-32,@GROFirma,GN,0,0,0,DATEDIFF(S,'19900101',GETDATE()) FROM (SELECT @GIDNumer as GIDNr,GN,Linki.KnL_GRONumer as GRO FROM #gronumery LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.KntLinki AS Linki ON Linki.KnL_GIDNumer=@GIDNumer AND Linki.KnL_GIDTyp = @GIDTyp AND Linki.KnL_GRONumer=GN) SelectWewn WHERE GRO IS NULL --insert brakujacych rekordow to KntLinki UPDATE CDN.KntLinki -- dodanie odpowiedniej LP SET KnL_LiczbaPowtorzen=KnL_LiczbaPowtorzen+(SELECT c FROM #gronumery WHERE GN=KnL_GRONumer), KnL_TStampDataMod = DATEDIFF(S,'19900101',GETDATE()) WHERE KnL_GiDTyp = @GidTyp AND KnL_GiDFirma = @GidFirma AND KnL_GiDNumer = @GidNumer AND KnL_GroTyp = @GroTyp AND KnL_GroFirma = @GroFirma AND KnL_GroNumer IN (SELECT GN FROM #gronumery) UPDATE CDN.KntLinki --ustawienie liscia SET KnL_Lisc=1,KnL_TStampDataMod = DATEDIFF(S,'19900101',GETDATE()) WHERE KnL_GiDTyp = @GidTyp AND KnL_GiDFirma = @GidFirma AND KnL_GiDNumer = @GidNumer AND KnL_GroTyp = @GroTyp AND KnL_GroFirma = @GroFirma AND KnL_GroNumer =@GROnumer DROP TABLE #gronumery FETCH NEXT FROM TriggerCursor INTO @GIDTyp,@GIDFirma,@GIDNumer,@GROTyp,@GROFirma,@GRONumer END CLOSE TriggerCursor DEALLOCATE TriggerCursor

CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.KntRodzice @GIDNumer int AS BEGIN DECLARE @n INT DECLARE @prevcount INT DECLARE @count INT
SET @count=-1 SET @prevcount=0
CREATE TABLE #tmpnumery(GN INT,C INT) INSERT INTO #tmpnumery VALUES(@GIDNumer,1)
WHILE (@prevcount!=@count) --przechodzenie grafu wszerz, jezeli nic nie dodano konczymy BEGIN INSERT INTO #tmpnumery SELECT DISTINCT KnG_GRONumer,0 FROM CDN.KntGrupy WHERE KnG_GIDNumer IN(SELECT GN FROM #tmpnumery) AND KnG_GIDTyp=-32 AND KnG_GIDNumer > 0 AND KnG_GRONumer NOT IN (SELECT GN FROM #tmpnumery) SET @prevcount=@count SET @count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #tmpnumery) END SET @prevcount=0 SET @count=-1 WHILE (@prevcount!=@count) BEGIN DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT GN FROM #tmpnumery OPEN c FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @n FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @n --pomijamy pierwszy rekord - dla niego C=1 IF (@count=-1) SET @count=0 WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN UPDATE #tmpnumery --podliczanie ilosci mozliwych sciezek jako sumy ilosci na elementach prowadzacych do elementu SET C=(SELECT SUM(C) FROM #tmpnumery WHERE GN IN (SELECT Kng_GIDNumer FROM CDN.KntGrupy WHERE Kng_GRONumer=@n AND Kng_GIDTyp=-32 AND KnG_GIDNumer > 0)) WHERE GN=@n SET @prevcount=@count SET @count=(SELECT SUM(C) FROM #tmpnumery) FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @n END CLOSE c DEALLOCATE c END SELECT * FROM #tmpnumery END
